author: Humblares
body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: Ingame

Staff Member: Crazy_

Guilty? (Yes or No): Yes

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: Hey guys. I was banned a week ago for racism towards a player. Id just like to say im sorry towards murphh.  I didnt mean for it to be hateful towards her.  im appealing because I wanna spend my christmas break playing avicus on public and scrimmages etc. if I didnt care about my ban i wouldnt be appealing right now. Hope you consider this appeal. Thanks Humblers.

Any additional comments?: Im Sorry Muphh I didnt mean to hurt your feeling.

title: Humblers Appeal

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Hi Humblers, thanks for the appeal. However, since the ban was valid, I don't see a reason to appeal it or shorten it. I'm glad you're apologetic for what you did, though you're still going to have to wait out the remaining 6 days of the ban (which expires on the 23rd).

This will still allow you to play during, and after Christmas. The appeal will remain unlocked for the next 24 hours, so if you have any concerns or question post them before then.

- Crazy
 



(just posting the evidence here so I don't forget about it - http://pastebin.com/1q9SgyyH)
